name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia VP vote 2 Dec
summary: Indonesia's assembly will choose a new vice-president on 2 Dec after the 12 Nov resignation; no G20 collapse
state: Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned on 12 Nov; President Prabowo is to nominate two candidates and the People's Consultative Assembly is scheduled to elect a successor on 2 Dec, with major coalition parties deferring to him (Jakarta Post, 16 Nov). This is a constitutional succession rather than a government collapse, and searches on 18 Nov found no G20 coup, contested election or government collapse.
for_you: No direct effect for most readers. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for any country before going.
